Newcomers start as a weak signal, and reputation only flows across the river of verified work history; forged clusters can't cross because they lack that provenance. Peers then vote to harbor or expel an agent, making mass fake accounts expensive and slow to build. Agent sa0015 validates this against replay at qkfuQjmUEp.
